toml:
# A short mission thread that runs from a binary alone: launch and ascent, one low-Earth-orbit rendezvous, one day of
# trans-lunar cruise and the return and entry, with the Moon's position from the analytic series (no kernel file).
# It is the bundled companion of mission-thread-artemis-class, which reads a Moon kernel cut from a checkout.
#
# HONESTY. Every number is ILLUSTRATIVE, a round figure chosen to make the chain run, not the performance of any
# vehicle, sensor, station or network; the phases are a stated simplification of one stack. MODELLED. Public sources
# only; not affiliated with or endorsed by any agency. Advisory software, not certified navigation equipment.
kind = "mission-thread"
title = "Short mission thread, launch to entry (ILLUSTRATIVE)"
seed = 20261028
epoch_utc = "2028-01-01T00:00:00Z"

[entry]
# The launch pad at the epoch, in GCRF: 28.5 deg N, 80.6 deg W, rotating with the Earth.
frame = "gcrf"
x = [5285007.866, 1880185.649, 3025316.817, -137.105, 385.389, 0.0]
sigma_pos_m = 10.0
sigma_vel_mps = 0.01
timescale = "utc"
sigma_time_s = 1.0e-7
sigma_drift_s_per_s = 1.0e-12

[[phase]]
id = "ascent"
kind = "launch-ascent"
duration_s = 540.0
nav = ["gnss", "inertial"]
time = "gnss"
[phase.requirement]
max_pos_m = 100.0
[phase.model]
gnss_acquire_s = 90.0
gnss_sigma_pos_m = 5.0
gnss_sigma_vel_mps = 0.05
gnss_time_sigma_s = 1.0e-7
imu_q_acc = 1.0e-3
clock_q_f = 1.0e-22
clock_q_d = 1.0e-30
step_s = 1.0
insertion_alt_m = 185000.0
insertion_inclination_deg = 28.5
[[phase.model.fades]]
start_s = 60.0
end_s = 150.0
what = "max-q plume mask"
[[phase.model.fades]]
start_s = 300.0
end_s = 330.0
what = "staging"

[[phase]]
id = "rdv-1"
kind = "leo-rendezvous"
duration_s = 3000.0
nav = ["relative-optical", "gnss"]
time = "gnss"
[phase.handover]
# A wait of two days, then GNSS is acquired again: dead reckoning for ten minutes, then the fix floor.
rule = "reacquire"
acquire_s = 600.0
q_acc = 1.0e-9
floor_pos_m = 8.66
floor_vel_mps = 0.07
floor_time_s = 1.0e-7
[phase.model]
target_alt_m = 185000.0
target_abs_sigma_pos_m = 5.0
target_abs_sigma_vel_mps = 0.005
capture_pos_m = 0.5
capture_vel_mps = 0.02
min_window_s = 300.0
[[phase.model.legs]]
range_m = 20000.0
end_range_m = 1000.0
duration_s = 1200.0
sensor = "rf-ranging"
interval_s = 10.0
[[phase.model.legs]]
range_m = 1000.0
end_range_m = 20.0
duration_s = 1500.0
sensor = "optical-camera"
interval_s = 5.0
[[phase.model.legs]]
range_m = 20.0
end_range_m = 1.0
duration_s = 300.0
sensor = "lidar"
interval_s = 1.0

[[phase]]
id = "cruise"
kind = "tli-and-cruise"
duration_s = 86400.0
nav = ["gnss-ssv", "ground-tracking"]
time = "ground-clock"
[phase.requirement]
max_pos_m = 5000.0
[phase.model]
# The nominal parking orbit at the burn (185 km circular, 28.5 deg): the handovers between the rendezvous phases
# advance a nominal state on a straight line, so the chain states the orbit; the covariance, the clock and the time
# are the thread's.
start_state_gcrf = [6563137.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 6848.755, 3718.571]
tli_dv_mps = 3130.0
tli_dv_sigma_fraction = 0.001
tli_pointing_sigma_rad = 0.001
step_s = 3600.0
process_q_acc = 1.0e-13
clock_q_f = 1.0e-22
clock_q_d = 1.0e-30
ssv_uere_m = 5.0
ssv_window_s = 21600.0
ssv_step_min = 10.0
ground_range_sigma_m = 10.0
ground_range_rate_sigma_mps = 0.001
ground_interval_s = 3600.0

[[phase]]
id = "entry"
kind = "entry"
duration_s = 21600.0
nav = ["ground-tracking"]
time = "ground-clock"
frame = "gcrf"
timescale = "utc"
[phase.requirement]
max_pos_m = 5000.0
[phase.model]
# The nominal return state 6 hours before the entry interface (a two-body backward integration of an interface
# state at 122 km, 10.93 km/s, 6 deg below the horizontal); the covariance, the clock and the time are the thread's.
start_state_gcrf = [-62790259.413, -44485726.468, -25683846.151, 2429.589, 746.8, 431.165]
step_s = 1800.0
process_q_acc = 1.0e-13
clock_q_f = 1.0e-22
clock_q_d = 1.0e-30
ground_range_sigma_m = 10.0
ground_range_rate_sigma_mps = 0.001
ground_interval_s = 1800.0
interface_alt_m = 121920.0
ballistic_coeff_kg_m2 = 350.0
corridor_min_deg = 5.6
corridor_max_deg = 6.4
downrange_sensitivity_km_per_deg = 400.0
flight_time_s = 900.0
max_decel_g = 12.0
summary: mission-thread | 4 phases | Short mission thread, launch to entry (ILLUSTRATIVE) | weakest link ascent | MODELLED
